brief:
The user likes documentaries but gave no specific examples or reasons for that preference.

They strongly disliked an unidentified Ali G movie and stopped after approximately 5–10 minutes; their account varies. They described it as absolutely awful. This disappointed them because they love the TV show and expected the movie to be much better. This does not establish a dislike of comedy generally.

They have not seen an unidentified Amy Schumer movie described as “the one with her with the alcohol bottle”; they only heard it was bad.

They have never seen The Matrix, though they have heard a lot about it and are familiar with references to the pills. They have not seen Wonder Woman either, but have heard that the Wonder Woman TV show is good. They expressed no firsthand judgment of either film.

They have seen and really enjoyed The Godfather, praising it as a very good piece of cinematic work and describing it as creative and inventive.
